title: Low balance alert
summary: Check your payments account's balance regularly and tell the owner when it drops below a level you set.
description: Every few hours, checks the naira balance of your payments account and, when it is below the amount you set, tells the owner so payouts do not fail for lack of funds. Works with Paystack, Moniepoint, iswallet, Flutterwave or Anchor; the owner hears on the WhatsApp or Telegram they linked to Taskiem, or by email.

params.name: threshold
params.title: Alert below (naira)
params.description: Text the owner when the balance is below this many naira.

params.name: every_hours
params.title: Check every (hours)
params.description: How often to check, in hours.

params.name: rail_connection
params.title: Payments account
params.description: The account whose balance is checked: any you connected that reports one.

params.name: funding_account
params.title: Wallet to check
params.description: Only for iswallet and Anchor, which hold several wallets: the one to check. Leave it blank otherwise.

steps.name: Tell the owner that the balance is low

input.message: ='Low balance: your payments account holds NGN ' + string(steps.balance.output.available_kobo / 100) + ', below your alert level of NGN ' + string(double({{threshold:kobo}}) / 100.0) + '. Top up to keep payouts running.'
